## Signature Moments

Name two or three client-appropriate moments that should make the rendered site memorable. Describe the page/section, intended feeling, and the compositional, typographic, background, image, video, or motion move that creates it.

Do not treat generic cards, oversized type, or animation alone as a signature moment. Each one must make the client's story clearer while remaining usable at mobile sizes.

## Background Strategy

Define an intentional route-wide background rhythm. Favour a coherent mix of high-contrast dark/light sections, varied colour fields, editorial crops, texture, and generated artwork over a flat, mostly-white canvas.

For every text-on-image or text-on-video treatment, name the scrim, gradient, crop, or solid fallback that protects readable text at mobile and desktop widths. Contrast must pass accessibility checks, not merely look bold.
